text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Hello?

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text:
“Ah, she picked up!” “Tact!” 
“Good morning!” “You're in Kyoto right 
now, right? 
Did you get a good night's sleep?”

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I slept soundly. 
Good morning, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
“Sorry to bother you on such an important 
day, Tact. 
Everyone just insisted on cheering you on 
in person, so...”

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm so very happy you did! 
Thank you all.

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text:
“See, what did I tell ya! I told ya Tact 
would 
be happy!” “We're all droppin' the farm 
work 
today to root for ya!”

text_block_list.name: Serious Man
text_block_list.text:
“Shigeaki next door ain't even the one 
running, 
and his stomach's been churning since last 
night!”

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
“Aw, don't mind that nonsense! Give it 
your best, 
Tact! Hang in there and give 'em hell!”

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text:
“Whoa, hold on, you wanna bust Tact's 
eardrums?!” 
“Don't worry 'bout it, keep 'em comin'!” 
“Tact, give 'em hell!”

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Wow...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Kyoto Racecourse really is gorgeous. 
And it's so massive...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I was amazed when I first saw Tokyo 
Racecourse, 
too, but are racecourses everywhere 
this enormous?
choice_data_list: The major racecourses usually are, yeah.
The major racecourses usually are, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... That means that many people 
come here to watch.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If things get crowded, there might even be 
more people here than the entire 
population of Hidaka...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It's truly breathtaking. 
The Twinkle Series...
choice_data_list: And today, you're joining their ranks.
And today, you're joining their ranks.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...My heart is pounding. Maybe I am 
nervous. 
Even so...

Daring Tact trailed off. 
Yet the sparkling gaze she turned toward 
the distant turf— 
spoke volumes about what was in her heart.
(Knock, knock...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hi, you two! 
Tact, how're you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart...! 
You came.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course! 
It's my precious, adorable junior's 
Make a Debut, after all!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What!? 
She was right here just a second ago...!
(THUD-THUD-THUD-THUD-THUD-THUD!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: No, these footsteps are...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —I FEEL DESTINY CALLING!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Epiphaneia...!

She was Epiphaneia. Though known for her 
fierce intensity, 
she was a powerhouse with two GⅠ victories 
to her name, 
exuding a truly overwhelming presence.
choice_data_list:
Uh, did you come here together with Daring 
Heart?

Uh, did you come here together with Daring 
Heart?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! But the "Voice of Destiny" pushed me 
forward, 
saying I needed a much more epic entrance!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So I sprinted all the way from the end of 
the hall 
and burst right through the door!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu. 
Epiphaneia really is always bursting with 
energy.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
! 
Yeah, now that's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Go get 'em, Tact, you're gonna do amazing! 
—I'm the one saying it, so you know it's a 
sure bet!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! 
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Epiphaneia? 
I was supposed to be the first one to 
cheer Daring Tact on!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Cesario was right... 
I've got to keep a closer eye on you...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, that's not the point! 
Hey, Daring Tact!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A Make Debut only happens once in a 
lifetime... 
So enjoy every single second of it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I know you have what it takes... 
I believe in you completely.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Yes! 
I'll do my absolute best!

With the push from her seniors, she seems 
more motivated than ever. 
I feel a little bad dampening the mood, 
but... there's something I just have to 
ask.
choice_data_list:
By the way, what's the deal with you and 
Epiphaneia...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It was right after I enrolled, I think... 
Epiphaneia was the one who approached me.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"—I know now! I came here at this very 
moment just so I could meet you!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"You and I are bound by an unbreakable 
destiny! What's your name?!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And ever since then, she's been looking 
out for me like this...

To be honest, I can't quite wrap my head 
around what Epiphaneia is talking about... 
but one thing is certain. And that is—
choice_data_list: You have so many people watching over you.

You have so many people looking out for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Before I knew it, 
I had formed bonds with so many people.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san. 
I... will do my best.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I want to get off to a great start 
today... 
and bring back wonderful news to everyone!
choice_data_list: Yeah, do your best out there!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Here I go!
